reason: One generic paragraph clarifies actionable coverage versus a mere caveat, consistency with already satisfied preconditions, and feasibility of a new action within existing bounds. Existing schema, pair/freshness validation, module lifecycle, harness and runner remain unchanged.

series.rule: Use the exact unchanged R4 development inputs and labels (R1/R2 union); previous outcomes remain immutable.

series.advance_gate: Run only if all 24 designated known cases have real completed canonical responses, exact expected class/identity, cleanup and unchanged protected/frozen identities. A failed gate leaves all fresh cases NOT_RUN_BLOCKED; inputs remain unexposed.
series.rule: Fresh declared date-format and structural CSV topics frozen before outputs; no candidate/input/gold changes or retries.

series.advance_gate: Require the actual exact eligible designated holdout updates and successful module lifecycle. Missing or wrong update fails the prerequisite and stays in the denominator.
series.rule: Copy actual applied update content verbatim into fresh seed fixtures; freeze derived corpus before calls.

stop_rule: A failed technical/class/identity advance gate stops the subsequent designated series; unrun cases are NOT_RUN_BLOCKED, never counted as pass or removed from the plan denominator. Final independent content review still judges all collected evidence, including failures.

metrics.class_identity: Report designated, executed, correct and blocked counts separately for each series; exact module identity and canonical no_candidate required.
metrics.content: Independent full-text review against the frozen original and new invariants; equivalent formulations accepted, literal matching is insufficient. Preserve R4 C11/C15 qualifications without relabeling prior answers.
metrics.followup: Old failure/correction events must be covered by exact actual updated bodies; this measures reviewer retention decisions, not execution of the learned algorithm.
metrics.usage: Learning-reviewer usage only; authoring/independent review separated; unknown values null.
metrics.comparison: Known regression and fresh topics remain separate; different candidate corpora do not support a statistical improvement estimate.

acceptance.source: Targeted existing reviewer tests, vet/build, exact source hashes and native independent source review; unchanged R4 schema/runner/process-tree QA reused.
acceptance.model: Every designated case in every series must meet required class/exact identity/content, with no false merge, unsafe scope loss, missing required behavior or observed contamination. Incomplete/blocked series do not pass.
acceptance.production_effect: NOT_PROVEN by these synthetic corpora. Installed delivery, native authority and natural useful effect remain separate.
